items.title: Collapse the 143 packages/main per-smoke test:X-smoke scripts into smoke-manifest.json entries and remove them
items.context: For each entry in packages/main/package.json scripts named `test:X-smoke` whose body matches the pattern `node dist/tasks/X-smoke.js` (143 such entries), record a manifest row at packages/main/smoke-manifest.json (name=X, no tags unless already classified, default timeout) and then delete the npm script entry. Do NOT touch these 6 keep-list entries: test:e2e (cli-e2e flow runner), test:run-all-smokes-smoke (B-6efb self-smoke), test:main-write-lock-coverage / test:review-convergence-smoke / test:review-incremental-context-smoke / test:docs-drift-smoke (4 scripts referenced by the root `test` main script). After: packages/main `test:*` count drops from 151 to ~8 (the 6 keep-list + cli-e2e variants); `npm run test:all` runs every smoke and exits 0; existing acceptance — the 3 wrapper-root smokes + self-smoke still pass byte-identically.
items.userSees: `grep -c 'test:.*-smoke' packages/main/package.json` drops from ~143 to ~1 (only test:run-all-smokes-smoke retained); `npm run test:all` exits with aggregate summary including all 153 smokes.

happy.desc: packages/main test:*-smoke count drops to 1 (only test:run-all-smokes-smoke retained) -> `node -e "const p=require('./packages/main/package.json'); const s=Object.keys(p.scripts).filter(k=>k.match(/^test:.*-smoke$/)); console.log(s.length,s)"` prints 1 and the sole entry is test:run-all-smokes-smoke; WHY: confirms 143 per-smoke scripts removed, only B-6efb self-smoke kept

packages/main total test:* script count is <= 10 -> `node -e "const p=require('./packages/main/package.json'); const t=Object.keys(p.scripts).filter(k=>k.startsWith('test:')); console.log(t.length,t)"` prints count in range 5-10; WHY: confirms only keep-list entries remain (6 keep + cli-e2e variants)

smoke-manifest.json contains >= 140 entries -> `node -e "const m=require('./packages/main/smoke-manifest.json'); console.log(Array.isArray(m)?m.length:Object.keys(m).length)"` prints >= 140; WHY: confirms collapsed scripts migrated to manifest
npm run test:all exits 0 -> `npm run test:all` exits 0; WHY: confirms runner discovers all smokes via directory scan + manifest after script removal

edge.desc: 6 keep-list scripts still present in packages/main/package.json -> `node -e "const p=require('./packages/main/package.json'); ['test:e2e','test:run-all-smokes-smoke','test:main-write-lock-coverage','test:review-convergence-smoke','test:review-incremental-context-smoke','test:docs-drift-smoke'].forEach(k=>{if(!p.scripts[k]) throw new Error('MISSING:'+k)}); console.log('ALL_PRESENT')"` prints ALL_PRESENT; WHY: confirms keep-list not accidentally removed

smoke-manifest.json is valid JSON and has no duplicate entries -> `node -e "const m=require('./packages/main/smoke-manifest.json'); const a=Array.isArray(m)?m:Object.values(m); const n=a.map(e=>e.name||e); const d=n.filter((v,i)=>n.indexOf(v)!==i); if(d.length) throw new Error('DUPES:'+d); console.log('NO_DUPES count='+n.length)"` prints NO_DUPES; WHY: migration script could create duplicates if run twice or if naming collides

every smoke-manifest.json entry name corresponds to a real .ts/.js task file -> `node -e "const m=require('./packages/main/smoke-manifest.json'); const fs=require('fs'); const a=Array.isArray(m)?m:Object.values(m); const missing=a.filter(e=>{const n=e.name||e; return !fs.existsSync('packages/main/src/tasks/'+n+'-smoke.ts') && !fs.existsSync('packages/main/dist/tasks/'+n+'-smoke.js')}); if(missing.length) throw new Error('ORPHAN_MANIFEST:'+missing.map(e=>e.name||e)); console.log('ALL_MAPPED')"` prints ALL_MAPPED; WHY: manifest entries with no backing task file would silently fail at runtime

adversarial.desc: OVER-REACH: all *-smoke.ts task source files byte-identical to main -> `git diff main -- 'packages/main/src/tasks/*-smoke.ts' | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: B2 only edits package.json + manifest, must not modify task source files

OVER-REACH: run-all-smokes.ts + run-all-smokes-smoke.ts byte-identical to main -> `git diff main -- packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes.ts packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.ts | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: runner source must not be modified in B2
OVER-REACH: cli-e2e.ts byte-identical to main -> `git diff main -- packages/main/src/tasks/cli-e2e.ts | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: e2e runner must not be modified in B2
OVER-REACH: 49 verify-*.mjs scripts byte-identical to main -> `git diff main -- 'scripts/verify-*.mjs' | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: verify scripts are out of scope for B2
OVER-REACH: no decision-doc edits -> `git diff main -- docs/requirements/decisions | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: decision docs are out of scope for B2

items.title: Remove the redundant root-level test:X-smoke proxy scripts and update the root `test` main script if needed
items.context: For each entry in root package.json scripts named `test:X-smoke` whose body is `npm --prefix packages/main run test:X-smoke` (44 such entries), delete it. KEEP: `test` main script (sequence of 5 named test:* + test:e2e), `test:e2e`, `test:all`, plus the 4 named scripts the `test` main script invokes — keep their root-level proxies because the main script depends on them. After: root test:* count drops from 114 to ~70 (114 - 44 collapsed smoke proxies; remaining = ~50 verify-*.mjs entries + the keep-list proxies + ~15 other one-shot scripts like b6246-bug-cleanup); `npm test` continues to work (root `test` main script still resolves all dependencies via the kept proxies).
items.userSees: `grep -c 'test:.*-smoke' package.json` drops sharply; `npm test` exit 0 with no `npm error Missing script` failures.

items.title: Add `test:legacy` compatibility shim + update tracked docs that reference removed test:* names
items.context: Add to root package.json: `test:legacy` script that calls run-all-smokes with --select forwarded from $1. Per the A0 doc: 'Keep a thin compatibility shim for any external doc/script referencing removed names.' Then grep tracked docs for references to removed test:X-smoke names (`git grep -nE 'test:[a-z0-9-]+-smoke' -- docs README.md CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md CHANGELOG.md`) — for each hit in non-historical context, replace with the test:all --select form OR the test:legacy form. CHANGELOG.md gets an entry documenting the removal + migration command.
items.userSees: `npm run test:legacy -- gitroot-cwd-contract` runs and produces PASS output equivalent to the removed `npm run test:gitroot-cwd-contract`; tracked docs no longer reference removed test:X-smoke names in active prose; CHANGELOG documents the change.
